subject: Thanks for applying to Acme Robotics
body_text:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for applying to Acme Robotics! We have received your application for the Senior Software Engineer, Platform role and our recruiting team is reviewing it now.

If your background is a match for what we're looking for, someone from our team will be in touch to schedule a first conversation.

Best,
The Acme Robotics Recruiting Team
snippet: Thanks for applying to Acme Robotics! We have received your application for the Senior Software Engineer
